materiality.rationale: vLLM v0.27.0 adds full-stack Kimi K3 support, new model integrations, a PyTorch/Triton upgrade, and expanded KV, offload, disaggregation, and serving features; it matters because a W33 runtime release changes both model coverage and deployment architecture, as stated in the project release.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This candidate matters for the issue because deployment support is part of a model's practical availability: vLLM's Kimi K3 path and memory/serving changes affect how operators can run new workloads.
